start: Staff & sign-in, a front desk person is on the list

user_sees: Tick box 'Trainer' with 'Sees the workout progress of the members you give them, in Training progress. Nothing else changes.'
The row pill changes from 'Staff' to 'Trainer'
must_not: The tick shown as set when the save failed

start: Staff & sign-in, the owner adds a new person and picks the job 'Trainer'

steps.action: Tap 'Add a person', type name and number, pick 'Trainer' under 'What is their job?'
user_sees: 'Same access as the front desk, plus the workout progress of the members you give them.'
must_not: A hint that promises more than front desk access

user_sees: Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
The new row has the pill 'Trainer' and the tick set
must_not: The person added as plain staff with the toast still saying only 'added'

start: The tick cannot be saved, or is not offered

steps.action: Tick Trainer with the internet off
user_sees: An error box under the tick; the tick stays as it was

steps.action: Open the page on a server that lacks the trainer part
user_sees: No Trainer tick on any row
must_not: A tick that fails on every tap

steps.action: Look at the page as a front desk person
must_not: Staff able to make themselves a trainer

start: A trainer with members given to them is unticked, then ticked again

must_not: The person still seeing members’ workout progress
A second trainer entry for the same person

steps.action: Tick 'Trainer' for a person who has a typed job such as 'Manager'
user_sees: The tick is set; the pill still reads 'Manager'
must_not: The owner unable to tell from the row that this person is a trainer, when the tick is hidden

start: What the tick opens to the ticked person

steps.action: Tick Trainer for a person, give them two members, let them sign in
user_sees: In Training progress they see those two members
must_not: Workout progress of members not given to them
Any change to what they may do at the desk
